hero.h1: Facebook Reels Downloader — Save Videos Online
hero.subtitle: Paste a supported public Facebook Reel or video link to check available download options in a few simple steps.

steps.title: How it works in three steps

items.title: Copy the link
items.text: In Facebook, open the Reel or video, tap Share and choose Copy link. On a computer, copy the address from the browser bar.

items.title: Paste and press Download
items.text: Paste the link above and press Download. The link is checked on our server only when you press the button.

items.title: Choose an option and save
items.text: If download options are available, pick one and save the file to your device. Only formats that really exist are shown.

features.title: Built to be simple and honest

items.title: No account needed
items.text: Use the tool without signing up. We never ask for your Facebook password, cookies or login.

items.title: Real options only
items.text: HD, SD or audio appear only when they are actually available for that video. Nothing is promised in advance.

items.title: Made for phones
items.text: A clean, fast, mobile-first layout that also works well on tablets and desktop computers.

items.title: Four languages
items.text: Use the site in English, French, Spanish or Arabic, with full right-to-left support for Arabic.

items.title: Light and dark themes
items.text: Follows your device setting by default and remembers your choice if you change it.

items.title: Clear explanations
items.text: When something fails, you get a plain-language reason and a next step instead of a vague error.

support.title: Supported content and limitations
support.intro: The tool is designed for content that is publicly available and that you are allowed to save.
supported: Public videos on Pages and profiles (facebook.com/…/videos/…)
unsupported: Private, friends-only, group-only or age-restricted videos
Videos that were deleted or whose owner removed access
Videos for which no downloadable format is available
Anything that would require logging in or bypassing a protection
support.note: Availability also depends on the video service connected to this site. Not every public video can be downloaded.

devices.title: Works on any device
devices.intro: You only need a modern browser. Here is the short version for each device; the guides in the blog go into more detail.

android.title: Android
steps: In the Facebook app, tap Share on the Reel and choose Copy link.
Open Chrome (or another browser) and go to this site.
Paste the link, press Download, then pick an option.
Find the file in the Files app under Downloads.

iphone.title: iPhone and iPad
steps: In the Facebook app, tap Share on the Reel and choose Copy link.
Open Safari and go to this site.
Paste the link, press Download, then confirm the download.
Open the Files app, go to Downloads, and use Share → Save Video if you want it in Photos.

desktop.title: Windows, Mac and Linux
steps: Open the Reel or video in your browser and copy the address from the address bar.
Paste it into the box above and press Download.
Choose an option; the file goes to your browser's Downloads folder.

items.title: "Private or inaccessible"
items.text: Only public videos can be processed. If you can only see the video while logged in, or only friends can see it, it cannot be downloaded here.

items.title: "Unavailable" or "invalid link"
items.text: Copy the complete link again with the Share → Copy link option. Cut-off links and links with extra text often fail.

items.title: "No downloadable format"
items.text: Some videos simply expose no downloadable file. Try again later; if it keeps happening there is nothing we can do for that video.

items.title: "Service temporarily unavailable" or "too many requests"
items.text: Wait a minute and try once more. Repeated rapid attempts trigger a temporary limit that protects the service.

items.title: The download link expired
items.text: Download links last only a short time. Press Download again to get a fresh one.

responsible.title: Privacy and responsible use
paragraphs: Videos belong to their creators. Save only what you own, what is clearly offered for download, or what you have permission to keep, and do not re-upload or sell other people's work.

We do not ask for Facebook credentials and we do not retain the videos you download. Like any website, our hosting and security systems may process technical data such as IP addresses; the Privacy Policy explains exactly what.

items.a: Yes. You can use the tool without paying or creating an account. The site may be supported by advertising, which never replaces or imitates the download controls.

Links to public Reels (facebook.com/reel/…), public videos (facebook.com/…/videos/…, facebook.com/watch/?v=…), share links (facebook.com/share/…) and short fb.watch links. Links from other websites are rejected.
No. Videos that are private, friends-only, in private groups or otherwise protected cannot be processed, and we never try to bypass privacy settings or login requirements.

items.q: Why does it say the video is unavailable?
items.a: The video may have been deleted, the owner may have changed its privacy, or the copied link may be incomplete. Copy the link again using Share → Copy link and retry.

items.q: Will I always get HD quality?
items.a: No. Quality depends on what Facebook makes available for that specific video. HD, SD or other options appear only when they genuinely exist.

items.q: Can I get just the audio (MP3)?
items.a: Only if an audio option is shown in the results for your video. It is not available for every video, and you should extract audio only from content you are authorized to use.

items.q: Do I need to log in to Facebook or share my password?
items.a: Never. Do not enter your Facebook password, cookies or tokens on this site. Legitimate use of the tool does not require any of them.

items.q: Where is the file saved on my phone?
items.a: On Android it normally goes to the Downloads folder (Files app). On iPhone and iPad, Safari saves it in Files → Downloads, from where you can share it to Photos.

items.q: How do I download on iPhone?
items.a: Copy the link in the Facebook app, open this site in Safari, paste the link, press Download and confirm. Our iPhone guide in the blog covers each step.

It depends on the video, how you use it and the laws where you live. Personal copies of your own content are generally fine; reposting other people's videos without permission may infringe copyright. This is general information, not legal advice.

items.q: Do you store my links or the videos I download?
items.a: We do not keep the video files. Files pass through our server only while being delivered, and results are cached in memory for a few minutes. Hosting and security logs may record technical data such as IP addresses. See the Privacy Policy for details.

items.q: Why did my download link stop working?
items.a: Download links are deliberately short-lived (about 15 minutes) for security. Press Download on the video again to get a new one.

items.q: Is this site affiliated with Facebook or Meta?
items.a: No. __BRAND__ is an independent website and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Facebook or Meta Platforms, Inc.

items.q: How do I report content or request removal?
items.a: Use the Copyright & Takedown page and the contact form. Include the information listed there so that we can review your request.
